name: P1 the disclosure field is dropped from the signed payload entirely
P2 the receipt CLAIMS the approver was authenticated when nothing checked
P3 a first-pass decision reports false instead of null (implies an approver was checked and rejected)
P4 a truthy caller-supplied value flips it to authenticated (the field becomes client-controlled)
P5 schema NOT bumped — an old verifier would print approver_id with no qualifier
P6 the Python verifier stops warning that the approver is unverified
from: print("    ⚠ approver identity: NOT AUTHENTICATED — asserted by the caller and never checked.")
